title: fix(app-shell): draw a served app label as served on every Console surface that names an app

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuXjFYoeducAp4ExBhc3f6eL)_

domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVwQZbHRRM9CaXeKif

Fixes #30311

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台所有显示应用名的地方（应用切换器、侧栏标题、首页应用卡片/应用条/最近访问、无权限页、AI 对话、应用市场「打开应用」按钮、报表索引）改为直接显示服务端已翻译好的应用名；应用卡片的描述同理。
- 为什么改：客户在 `.custom` 配对包里给已安装应用改名后，服务端（#30353）已按裁定顺序返回新名字，但前端又用基础包的 `apps.NAME.label` 译文盖回去，中文下仍显示旧名。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `ui/packages/app-shell` 的读取顺序；草稿预览（`?preview=draft`）、键式标签、无标签应用仍走前端词条，未改名的应用显示不变。回滚即撤本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useServedAppLabel.ts`（新 helper 的取值顺序），再看 `layout/AppSwitcher.tsx` 一处调用点。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useServedAppLabel-30311.test.tsx`，预期 18 条全绿；修复前的取值顺序下其中 5 条是红的。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- New private hook `useServedAppLabel` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useServedAppLabel.ts`). `appLabel(app)` draws a served `label` (a string, or an inline locale map resolved by `metadataText`) as given; `appDescription(app)` does the same for `description`. The bundle (`useObjectLabel().appLabel` / `appDescription`, the `apps.NAME.label` lookup) is asked only for text no server translated: an item stamped `_draft: true` by `?preview=draft`, a keyed `{ key, defaultValue }` label (still resolved through `t`, as before), or an app with no label / description.
- Every app-shell surface that named an app through `useObjectLabel().appLabel({ name, label: resolveKeyedI18nLabel(app.label, t) })` now calls `useServedAppLabel().appLabel(app)`: 17 call sites in 11 files, taken from the tree at `fdd06415` (`AppSwitcher` x3, `AiChatPage` x4, `HomePage` x2, `UnifiedSidebar`, `AppHeader` hidden-app menu, `AppNoAccessEmptyState`, `AppCard` label and description, `HomeAppsStrip`, `MarketplacePage`, `MarketplacePackagePage`, `AppReportIndexView`).
- `useNavTargetLabel.ts` and `ui/packages/i18n/**` are untouched (claim fences); the hook only imports the exported `metadataText`.
- Root changeset `.changeset/30311-served-app-labels.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

## Why

Since #30353 the server serves an overridden app's label in the ruled order (the `.custom` pair's own text over the base package's translation). The Console handed that served label to the bundle lookup as its fallback, so the base package's `apps.NAME.label` translation won it back and a renamed app kept its old name on zh-CN. The object / view half of #30311 landed in #30388 with the same served-first rule; this is the app half.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useServedAppLabel-30311.test.tsx` (new, 18 cases): the real hook over the real `useObjectLabel` inside a real `I18nProvider` with a packaged catalogue, en and zh-CN: a renamed served label and description draw as served; an unedited one shows the server's translation; an inline locale map resolves in the active language; controls for a `_draft` item, a keyed label, an absent / empty label and a translation-only description keep the bundle. Plus a census: no non-test source under `app-shell/src` other than the hook destructures `appLabel` / `appDescription` from `useObjectLabel()` (with a positive control that the walk reaches the hook and `AppSwitcher.tsx`, and that the pattern matches the banned shape).

## Acceptance notes

- **Evidence branch deviation.** The dispatch asked for screenshots on a never-merged evidence branch; this card thread can push only its designated branch, so the PNGs were committed at `71a58ff3` and removed again in the next commit. The PR squash-merges, so they never reach `main`; the links below point at that commit.
- **CommandPalette** already drew `resolveKeyedI18nLabel(app.label, t)` without the bundle, so it showed the served name before this PR and is unchanged.
- The live leg exercised the app switcher pill, the sidebar title and Home (app card, recent row app name). The marketplace "Open app" button, the AI chat, the no-access state and the report index's other-app links are pinned by the census and the hook cases, not browser-measured.

## Verification

<details><summary>Live, showcase --fresh, zh-CN, Console from ui/ src through Vite, 1440 wide</summary>

Override written the way the platform takes it: `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` (pair `com.example.showcase.custom`, created), then `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/showcase_app?package=com.example.showcase.custom&mode=draft` with the served app body, `label: Showcase Hub (renamed-30311)` and `overrides: { package: 'com.example.showcase', basedOn: '0.1.0' }`, then `POST /api/v1/meta/app/showcase_app/publish?package=com.example.showcase.custom` (seq 2). `GET /meta/app/showcase_app` then serves `Showcase Hub (renamed-30311)` under both `Accept-Language: zh-CN` and `en`; the zh-CN catalogue keeps `apps.showcase_app.label` = 功能展示.

| Console, zh-CN, same override | `origin/main` app-shell sources (`fdd06415`, restored into the tree, Vite `--force`) | this branch |
|:--|:--|:--|
| app switcher pill | 功能展示 | Showcase Hub (renamed-30311) |
| `/apps/showcase_app` page text matches | renamed 0, 功能展示 1 | renamed 1, 功能展示 0 |
| Home matches (app card + recent row) | renamed 0, 功能展示 1 | renamed 2, 功能展示 0 |
